description: Text model vs all 50 human items, film-block bootstrap CI. D1: seconds restricted to ∩ of all three models + human when all three signals exist for a film. D2: pooled_r_centered z-scores within film before concat; fisher_z_mean_r is equal-film Fisher-z mean of per-film r. D3: BH-FDR q-values — family = 50 GRID items within model (q_bh_within_model_50) and 150 = 50×3 (q_bh_all_150). nominal_p from Fisher-z is approximate (1 Hz series are autocorrelated).
